summary.text: Jeff Witte is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 57B, in office since 2023, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Democrat Brian Cohn is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Witte lives in Lakeville, Minnesota, and earned a B.S. in social work and criminal justice from Winona State University in 1988 and an M.A. in police leadership, administration and education from the University of St. Thomas in 2007.

His career experience includes working as a community service officer, police officer and police sergeant at the Burnsville Police Department, and he served as a planning commissioner for the City of Lakeville.
Jeff Witte defeated Brian Cohn in the November 5, 2024 general election.
Witte's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Public Safety and Criminal Justice Reform Finance and Policy Committee (as Co-Vice Chair) and the House Taxes Committee.
